warning: Research only: no odds, ROI, stakes, or evidence of beating bookmakers. Schedule observation times are reconstructed; result availability assumes +24h after scheduled start. Historical revisions are not verified. Validation is development data; repeated optimization can overfit it.

candidate.primary: logistic regression, all eleven features, lambda=0.01, sigmoid calibration
candidate.standardization: mean/scale fitted on refit rows only
candidate.calibration: single sigmoid (intercept + exp slope, L2 0.001) fitted on calibration period only

comparators.home_rate: constant home-win rate of the refit rows
comparators.boosted: secondary; four predeclared candidates selected on the tune period

metric_plan.primary: calibrated logistic minus Elo paired log-loss difference, 95% seven-day block bootstrap (1000 resamples, seed 42)
secondary: Brier and accuracy for all families
rules: Only the primary comparison is confirmatory.
Intervals exclude training and model-selection uncertainty and are not multiplicity-corrected.
No result here is evidence of a betting edge, ROI or executable price.
A disappointing result is not grounds to re-tune and re-score; the holdout is spent either way.

note: Local tamper evidence and a one-use record, not an independent preregistration service. Scoring the holdout is irreversible: afterwards 2025-26 is development data and cannot back a fresh-holdout claim.
